# OopsMyPassword (https://oopsmypassword.web.app)

> Privacy-first cybersecurity tools, structured Academy courses (Cyber Security, OSINT, Pentesting, Web Application Security), OSINT & Pentest tool directories, CLI cheat sheets, and technical security guides. All interactive tools run 100% client-side in the browser with zero telemetry.

## Interactive Client-Side Security Tools
- [Password Strength Checker](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/checker): Real-time local entropy, pattern detection, and crack-time estimation.
- [CSPRNG Password Generator](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/generator): Generates random passwords using window.crypto.getRandomValues().
- [Breach Check (k-Anonymity Demo)](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/breach-check): Zero-knowledge 5-hex-character SHA-1 prefix range lookup.
- [Google Dork & OSINT Search Query Builder](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/dork-builder): Visual composer for site:, filetype:, inurl:, intitle:, and intext: queries with 24 presets.
- [Client-Side Hash, JWT & Encoding Inspector](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/hash-inspector): Offline WebCrypto SHA-256/384/512 calculator, password hash identifier, and JWT security auditor.
- [Phishing URL & Suspicious Link Risk Scanner](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/url-scanner): Lexical URL analyzer for IDN homograph punycode (xn--), @-authority confusion, and brand typosquatting.
- [Diceware Passphrase Generator](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/passphrase): Multi-word passphrases with exact bit-entropy calculation.
- [Password Entropy Calculator](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/entropy): Interactive character pool and keyspace calculator.
- [Password Health Audit](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/password-health): 10-point local credential hygiene check.
- [Security Checklist](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/security-checklist): 16-step account hardening tracker.

## Structured Academy Tracks & Hubs
- [OMP Academy Home](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/learning): 118+ interactive lessons with 4-question self-checks and Full/Step reader modes.
- [OSINT Hub](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/osint): 20+ OSINT investigation tools with interactive CLI builders and side-by-side comparison drawer.
- [Pentest Hub](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/pentest): Authorized penetration testing tools by phase with interactive CLI command builders.
- [Tool Comparisons Hub](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/compare): 12 head-to-head technical comparisons.
- [CLI Cheat Sheets Hub](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/cheatsheets): 10 interactive, printable command references.
- [Security Glossary](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/glossary): 30 foundational security, cryptography, and OSINT term deep-dives.
- [Articles & Security Research](https://oopsmypassword.web.app/articles): Long-form cybersecurity guides and threat analysis.
